text: 据北京市统计局消息，1-7月，全市房地产开发投资同比下降11.6%，房屋施工面积9356.9万平方米，下降6.3%，其中住宅施工面积4684.9万平方米，下降5.3%。全市商品房销售面积609.1万平方米，同比增长1.4%，其中，住宅销售面积447.7万平方米，增长14.9%，保障性住宅是主要带动因素。1-7月，全市市场总消费额同比增长1.8%。其中，服务性消费额增长4.6%，信息、交通、体育等领域较快增长；实现社会消费品零售总额7517.5亿元，下降2%，降幅比上半年收窄0.2个百分点。社会消费品零售总额中，按消费形态分，商品零售6776.6亿元，下降
text_en: According to the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Statistics, from January to July, Beijing's real estate development investment fell 11.6% year-on-year; floor space under construction totaled 93.569 million sqm, down 6.3%, including residential space of 46.849 million sqm, down 5.3%. Commercial housing sales totaled 6.091 million sqm, up 1.4% year-on-year, with residential sales at 4.477 million sqm, up 14.9%, driven mainly by affordable housing. From January to July, total market consumption rose 1.8% year-on-year, with service consumption up 4.6%—led by information, transportation, and sports—while retail sales of consumer goods totaled 751.75 billion yuan, down 2%, narrowing by 0.2 percentage points from the first half.
